title: A Primer of the Thrown Cord
summary: Teaches the grip, the stance and the plain overarm cast of the bolas to a first-time student using body strength.

title: Handbook of Weight and Tether
summary: Drills the measure of cord length and the swing of the weight for students who have only begun to harden the skin.

title: The Hobbling Drill-Book
summary: Gives daily drills for casting the bolas low at the legs of a running animal or man without any qi.

title: Workbook of the Whirling Stone
summary: Builds the steady overhead whirl and the clean release of the stone weights in students with trained tendons.

title: Plain Treatise on Leg-Snaring
summary: Explains how the cords wrap a target's legs and how the thrower finishes the capture with body strength alone.

title: Field Canon of the Three-Ball Throw
summary: Teaches the three-weight cast and the first use of circulating qi to steady the release, for students past the Second Awakening.

title: Catcher's Handbook of the Cord Line
summary: Shows a mounted or foot catcher how to run a cord line across a fleeing target's path, with light qi at the wrist.

title: A Herdsman's Guide to the Running Snare
summary: A working guide to snaring running stock and men by the legs, with a little qi circulating in the throwing arm.

title: Primer of Breath on the Cord
summary: Ties the breath to the whirl and release of the bolas so a student with circulating qi casts with even timing.

title: Handbook of the Spinning Release
summary: Drills the hip turn, the spin and the late release that carry the bolas farther, using qi sparingly in the arm.
